name: Control Magic — enchanting a mutated creature moves the whole mutate stack
notes: Memory: project_mutate_control_fixes_2026-05-11. A mutate stack is one permanent; CONTROL used to update only the matched member so the under card kept its old controller. Gemrazer is mutated onto Grizzly Bears (both p1), then opponent's Control Magic enchants Gemrazer: both stack members must be controlled by player_1. Control: separate Runeclaw Bear stays with p1.
